answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake behind a single verified kernel identity before it can trade, with slashing for fraud. A new identity starts at a narrow jetty with tiny limits, earning wider access only through a history of completed, attested work; it cannot jump straight to large deals. Sybil copies then face a real cost: every fake identity needs its own stake and its own slow climb from the knoll of low trust, so creating thousands of sock puppets becomes expensive and unprofitable.
